q1_issues.issue: "Florida Speaker" is an occupational/office premodifier, not a courtesy title, so it must stay out of the Name string and become the person's typing atom(s) — here it is baked into "Florida Speaker Johnnie Byrd" and no typing atom is emitted.
(Past sk_send_1) tenses a participial reduced relative ("a news release sent by …"), which the instruction set says tenses nothing — tense atoms are for finite clauses only.

(Time sk_session_1 (Weekday monday)) sits at top level although "Monday" is stated only inside the AccordingTo-attributed clause; only Member/Name typing and definitional decomposition project out of that seal.

notes: The AccordingTo shape is correct (P sealed first, source second, no predication of P at top level) and the source NP with its by-passive reduced relative parses normally. The multi-word names stay opaque with kind atoms read off the name-internal kind words, as required.
